text_block_list.text:
This morning, I awoke with the sunrise,
so I decide
to head to the academy
early.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. It really is a
lovely day,
don't you think? ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
choice_data_list: Morning! You seem to be in a good mood.

text_block_list.text:
Well, I had a wonderful koto lesson on
my day off
yesterday.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's such a rewarding feeling—producing
beautiful
tones with your own two hands.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Now I'm ready to hop right back on the
path to
the top at full strength. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It sounds like Грасс Вандер was able to
rest well
during her day off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
